status: preregistered before c112 pilot or candidate measurement
purpose: Measure the untested concurrency point between the qualified c96 optimum and the unstable c128 negative. No rate or output oracle is transferred across shapes.
hardware: Two local Intel Arc Pro B70 cards; no remote host.
fixed_configuration: Qwen3.8-27B Q4_K_M, llama.cpp SYCL TP2 tensor 1,1, MTP0, 112 pinned slots, requested total context 32768, batch 2048, ubatch 256, FUSE_EXT=31, temperature 0, prompt cache off, 128 generated token IDs/request, admission target 112 with 1000 ms ceiling. The exact effective context is recorded from the live server and must not be inferred in advance.
stage_1_oracle_pilot: A fresh cache-off control server runs the complete c112 batch with PILOT_MODE=1. Its rate is diagnostic/nonpublic. It must pass completeness, zero-cache, liveness and health gates before its 112-row same-shape batch oracle is frozen and committed.
stage_2_candidate: A fresh server enables the qualified exact F16 cache pair ffn_down,ffn_gate and runs against the frozen c112 oracle.
incumbent: Qualified c96 rates 192.35094949480367 and 192.3329581230704 tok/s; center 192.34195380893704 tok/s. c128 is closed and supplies neither a rate nor an oracle.
advance_rule: Candidate attempt 1 must match the frozen c112 batch oracle 112/112, pass all gates and exceed 192.35094949480367 tok/s. Only then repeat. Promotion requires both candidate attempts 112/112 and their center above 192.34195380893704 tok/s.
failure_policy: Any pilot gate failure, candidate mismatch, OOM/health failure or first candidate rate at or below 192.35094949480367 closes r20. Pilot and failed-arm rates are never promoted.
